notes: P03 baseline fidelity adapters for PST 2027 (ReceiptMin: Measuring Forensic Reconstructability under Purpose-Bound Audit Minimization). evaluation/venue2027/pst/baselines.py implements run_baseline(baseline_id, case, ctx) -> Outcome, BASELINE_REGISTRY, refuse_constant_stub, reconstructability(event_case, audit_set) -> float, linkability_score(audit_set, aux_data) -> float, and compute_frontier(cases) -> dict[str, FrontierPoint]. In-process arms: B0 full audit retention (utility upper bound 1.0, high linkability ~0.95), B1 minimized without receipts (stripping evidence without receipts loses reconstructability < 0.25 vs B0), B2 minimized + receipt anchoring (tamper-evident Merkle/witness anchoring and commitment digests recover reconstructability >= 0.85 with reduced linkability ~0.35-0.45), B3 candidate ReceiptMin (purpose-bound HMAC commitment receipts, epoch-keyed pseudonyms, and retention maps recover reconstructability >= 0.85 while minimizing linkability <= 0.20, optimizing the frontier). Unavailable external upstreams (RFC 9162 ct-merkle, encrypted-log KMS, Macaroons NDSS 2014, OpenFGA, Zanzibar, FHIR R5, MUSE, RATS RFC 9334, NIST ABAC, WHO 2021) return NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL with BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE; never a toy substitution under the pinned name (EXECUTION_CONTRACT rule 8). refuse_constant_stub replays paired answerable/unanswerable probe cases and refuses constant-perfect, detect-all, and detect-none stubs (CONSTANT_STUB_REFUSED / STUB_DETECT_ALL_REFUSED) while admitting discriminating adapters (STUB_SEPARATION_OK). compute_frontier computes strictly from evaluated sample cases, refusing empty samples with SAMPLE_EMPTY (no invented numbers beyond computed sample). 21 unit tests in test_baselines.py pass; full evaluation/venue2027 suite 2087 tests pass; ruff check clean.
